name: @notarium/monorepo
description: Notarium — a modern, self-hosted, AI-agent-native knowledge workspace with an Obsidian-style knowledge graph, on a markdown-file-first engine
author: Sergey Padurets

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "PORT=${API_PORT:-3001} tsx watch packages/server/src/apps/server/main.ts" "npm run dev -w @notarium/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @notarium/web && npm run build -w @notarium/server
scripts.test:pg: vitest run --no-file-parallelism test/meta-db-contract/postgres.test.ts test/meta-db-contract/postgresMigrations.test.ts test/meta-db-contract/pgLockOrder.test.ts test/meta-db-contract/pgLockPairs.test.ts test/integration/pgOAuth.test.ts
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:fake; fake=$?; npm run e2e:real; real=$?; [ $fake -eq 0 ] || exit $fake; exit $real
scripts.e2e:docker: HOST_UID=$(id -u) HOST_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f docker/compose.test.yml run --rm pw npm run e2e
scripts.visual: HOST_UID=$(id -u) HOST_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f docker/compose.test.yml run --rm pw npx playwright test test/visual
scripts.visual:update: HOST_UID=$(id -u) HOST_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f docker/compose.test.yml run --rm pw npx playwright test test/visual --update-snapshots
scripts.demo:shots: HOST_UID=$(id -u) HOST_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f docker/compose.test.yml run --rm -e LOCALE -e DEMO_PORT -e DEMO_NOW pw npx playwright test -c playwright.demo.config.ts
scripts.demo:preview: HOST_UID=$(id -u) HOST_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -f docker/compose.test.yml run --rm -e LOCALE -e DEMO_HERO -e DEMO_PLATE_HERO -e DEMO_SET pw npx tsx scripts/demoPreview.ts
